title: Skills-root registry (skills-root/v1)
description: Agent-independent SKILLS_ROOT registry written under <HOME>/governance/skills_root.json. Hosts are adapters only; portfolio_manifest is the vendor-pin skill-id set. install_mode is junction|copy only.

skills_root.description: Absolute or ~ path to the one product skills tree.

install_mode.description: copy = recipient product bytes under SKILLS_ROOT; junction = author/advanced links into existing roots. Claude adapter is always pointer-only (never a second product tree).

hosts_registered.description: Hosts whose adapter register actually succeeded this run. Honesty: never stamp a host that did not register.

portfolio_manifest.description: Vendor-pin skill-id list (inline array) or a non-empty ref string naming the pin source.
